# LLaVA-NeXT vision reference fixtures

What the Rust LLaVA-NeXT image input must reproduce, generated by Hugging Face's
own processor and `pack_image_features` (transformers 5.14.1, Pillow 12.3) on the
configs and tokenizer of OpenVINO/llava-v1.6-mistral-7b-hf-int4-ov, no weights:

```
python tools/vlm_fixtures/gen_llava_next_fixtures.py --model <export dir> \
    --images crates/cascadia-engine-openvino/tests/fixtures/pixtral_vision \
    --out crates/cascadia-engine-openvino/tests/fixtures/llava_next_vision
```

- Images: the eight Pixtral fixture PNGs (read from `../pixtral_vision`).
- `reference.json`:
  - `images.<name>`: pinpoint, tile grid, view count, a summary of the PIL
    processor's `pixel_values` (`[views, 3, 336, 336]`), the torchvision
    processor's distance from it, HF's token count, and the packed row layout
    as runs of source rows (`[-1, n]` is n newline rows).
  - `counts`: HF's token count for a 43x43 sweep of `(height, width)`.
  - `prompts.<name>`: the processor's template and `input_ids`, and the prompt
    Cascadia renders (`served_template`), whose ids the generator checked equal.
